text: Assumption: Simultaneous read accesses are thread-safe — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Simultaneous read accesses are thread-safe — is this correct?
norm: simultaneous read accesses are thread safe
rationale: The method is declared as const and noexcept and does not modify the object, although concurrency is not explicitly specified in the payload.
